description: Open a pull request: { repo: "owner/name", title, body, head, base?, draft? } -> { output: <pr url> }. head is required: the worker runs outside any checkout, so gh cannot infer a current branch.

base.description: Base branch to merge into (gh default: the repo default branch).

head.description: Head branch the PR ships. Required: the worker runs outside any checkout, so gh cannot infer a current branch.

response_schema.description: Trimmed stdout of a mutating gh command (gh prints the created/updated URL or a confirmation line; some commands print nothing).
response_schema.title: TextResponse
